resources.string: Speaker correction (runs after JamesDSP effects when on)
Adds fullness and weight to the bass. About 0.15 s of delay

Virtual bass is experimental.

• The effect and any harshness depend on the song and on the phone.
• If you hear buzzing or a mechanical sound, lower the strength or use the "More fullness" mode. The "Deep bass" mode can buzz on songs with dense bass.
• It adds about 0.15 s of delay, so video may look slightly out of sync.
• Avoid long listening at maximum volume: small speakers can overheat.
